description: Run a ZOQL query (e.g. "SELECT Id, Name FROM Account") against the configured Zuora tenant. Returns immediately with a job_id and status 'queued' (D0.3 deferred-completion shape) -- the dispatch returning is NOT the same as the job finishing. When the job completes, the result is ALWAYS written to the caller-supplied output_tsv_path, never returned inline. Zuora's own ZOQL query call (POST /v1/action/query) returns at most 2000 records per call; this verb follows the vendor's own queryMore continuation automatically when more remain. The row limit below is entirely our own policy. Defaults to 500 records to avoid exhausting API request limits and disk, and to discourage pulling all records for client-side filtering that a ZOQL WHERE clause should do instead. To fetch more, pass acknowledge_default_limit_override=true together with an explicit row_limit (up to 1000) -- both are required together, and a row_limit above 1000 is refused rather than silently clamped. For pulls beyond 1000 records, use bulk_export instead (same override mechanism, hard cap 50000). When the goal is validating that records exist or picking one to act on next, prefer selecting stable ID fields over email addresses or other PII-bearing fields -- the ZOQL SELECT list decides what comes back, so a narrower query is both cheaper and lower-exposure.
embedding_description: Run an ad-hoc ZOQL query against the Zuora billing tenant (accounts, subscriptions, invoices, payments) and write matching records to a workspace TSV -- up to 1000 with an acknowledged override, 500 by default. Dispatches asynchronously: a job_id comes back at once, the TSV handle lands moments later. Use bulk_export for larger pulls; prefer stable ID fields over PII for validation reads.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dispatch envelope: job_id (string) and status ('queued'). This is NOT the query result -- the TSV handle (path, columns, row_count, total_size, truncated) arrives separately, as its own message, when the job completes.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: This call only confirms the query was queued -- do not present job_id/status as the query result. Acknowledge the request is in flight; the TSV handle lands in a follow-up message when the job completes. Once delivered, confirm the written path, the row_count, and the column list. The file contains potentially sensitive billing/financial data (data_sensitivity 0.5) -- name the path for downstream use but do not inline its contents. If truncated is true, warn that the query hit the effective limit and point to a higher acknowledged row_limit (up to 1000, or bulk_export beyond that) if more is needed.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Run a ZOQL query against the configured Zuora tenant and write the result to a tab-separated file in the operator's workspace, up to an acknowledged override ceiling.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: zuora.invalid_params: missing zoql/output_tsv_path, the path's parent directory does not exist, acknowledge_default_limit_override and row_limit were not given together, or row_limit exceeded the 1000 hard cap. zuora.export_path_refused: the path is not absolute, not a .tsv, or not contained under any operator-configured export_allowed_roots entry (an empty export_allowed_roots refuses every export by default). zuora.query_failed: the ZOQL is invalid or references an unknown object/field. zuora.auth_failed: the OAuth client credentials were rejected. zuora.rate_limited: the tenant's API rate limit was exceeded.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: zuora.invalid_params naming the override pair: pass BOTH acknowledge_default_limit_override=true and an explicit row_limit, or neither (for the 500-record default); a row_limit above 1000 is refused outright, not clamped -- use bulk_export for larger pulls. zuora.export_path_refused: pass an ABSOLUTE path ending in .tsv under a configured workspace root; if export_allowed_roots is empty, add the operator's export directory to the zuora_plugin config and reload the plugin config. zuora.invalid_params with a missing-parent message: create the parent directory first. zuora.query_failed: check the ZOQL syntax and object/field names. zuora.rate_limited: retry after a short delay. zuora.auth_failed: ask the operator to check the OAuth client_id/client_secret.
